notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{R}{R}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Selvala and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least 2 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
